subject: Midwindow billing: reallocate seats + storage add-on — invoice routing for Solacity
body:
From: Marco Diaz <m.diaz@solacity.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
Cc: Solacity Finance <billing@solacity.com>, Elena Kirov <e.kirov@solacity.com>
Date: Sun, 7 Mar 2027 09:12:00 +0100
Subject: Re: mid-period billing question — entity split and storage change

Hi Olga,

Quick context: we started the month on our HQ entity (Solacity Labs GmbH, DE) for the committed capacity (40 seats). On 2027-03-10 we moved 18 seats + the new storage addon (2TB) to a newly invoiced subsidiary (Solacity EU Ops B.V.). We need the March invoice to reflect:

- a prorated credit on the 18 seats that moved off the HQ entity for the unused days in March;
- a prorated charge on the 2TB storage add-on on the subsidiary for the portion of March after activation;
- final decision on whether Redwood can issue a single invoice to the HQ with an internal transfer to the subsidiary OR two separate invoices (one per entity). Our AP team needs the invoice(s) to show each Dutch entity VAT number correctly so they can process the payment.

I've attached a one-pager from our side (solacity_entity_statement.pdf) and our registration for the Dutch entity. Can you confirm next steps, expected credit amount, and whether you can route collection to two entities?

Thanks,
Marco
Finance Lead — Solacity Labs

---

On Mon, 8 Mar 2027 at 11:03:00 +0100, Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com> wrote:
To: Marco Diaz <m.diaz@solacity.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Solacity Finance <billing@solacity.com>, Elena Kirov <e.kirov@solacity.com>
Subject: Re: mid-period billing question — entity split and storage change

Hi Marco — thanks for the note and the attachments. We can accommodate the entity split, but there are a few items we need to confirm so our billing system can generate accurate invoices and compute prorations:

1) Effective transfer timestamp (you listed 2027-03-10). Please confirm the local time (we'll assume 00:00 UTC unless you specify otherwise).
2) Which entity should receive the remaining committed seats (18 seats -> Solacity EU Ops B.V.) and which entity should retain the remaining 22 seats (Solacity Labs GmbH)?
3) VAT numbers for both entities (we have the Dutch VAT in your PDF but need the full registration number exactly as your AP expects).
4) Preferred invoice routing:
   - Option A: Two invoices for March (one for each legal entity) with prorated lines split by days; or
   - Option B: Single invoice to HQ with an internal memo line and a credit note issued to HQ and a charge to the subsidiary (some customers prefer this for a single payment flow).

Our standard proration method: daily pro-rata based on calendar days in the invoice period. Example calc we will apply if you confirm 2027-03-10 transfer at 00:00 UTC and billing month = March (31 days):

- Seats moved: 18 seats
- Unit price per seat (monthly): EUR 2,000
- Days before transfer (Mar 1–9 inclusive): 9 days -> HQ keeps charges for first 9 days on 22 seats; HQ should be charged 22 * 2,000 * (31/31) minus credit for 18 seats for 22 days;
- Credit for HQ for moved seats = 18 * 2,000 * (22/31) = EUR 25,419.35 (rounded)
- Charge to subsidiary for moved seats = 18 * 2,000 * (9/31) = EUR 10,387.10 (rounded)

Storage add-on (2TB) activated on 2027-03-10: charge to subsidiary = monthly price * (22/31) if activated at start of transfer day; we will confirm the pro-rata direction once you confirm the exact effective hour.

Next actionable items from our side after confirmation:
- Generate provisional proration worksheet and share proration_calculation.csv (attached);
- Draft one or two invoice PDFs depending on your choice of Option A or B;
- If Option A, we will need both VAT numbers and billing addresses; if Option B, we'll need a signed internal payment mandate from HQ to route the net payment to the subsidiary (we can accept DocuSign).

I've attached an initial proration_calculation.csv showing line-level math; please review and tell us which of the two invoice routing options you prefer.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Senior Billing Manager | Redwood Inference

---

On Tue, 9 Mar 2027 at 14:22:00 +0100, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com> wrote:
To: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Solacity Finance <billing@solacity.com>, Marco Diaz <m.diaz@solacity.com>
Subject: Re: mid-period billing question — entity split and storage change

Looping in accounting to confirm: we can do Option A (two invoices) with our current ledger setup. Accounting note: when issuing two invoices, VAT reverse charge logic will apply for intra-EU supplies depending on the VAT numbers provided; please confirm EU VAT IDs before we finalize. Also, if the customer wants us to net the credit and charge and issue a single payment request (Option B), that will require a payment mandate doc and may delay the invoice date by 1 business day.

Jonas
Revenue Ops — Redwood Inference

---

On Wed, 10 Mar 2027 at 09:08:00 +01:00, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com> wrote:
To: Marco Diaz <m.diaz@solacity.com>, Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Subject: Re: mid-period billing question — entity split and storage change

Thanks Marco — we reviewed your attachments. We are happy to proceed with Option A (two invoices) to keep entity-level VAT clean for AP.

Action plan and timeline:
- Today (Mar 10): Redwood generates provisional invoices and proration worksheet and shares them with Solacity.
- Tomorrow (Mar 11): Customer signs DocuSign (if needed) for subsidiary billing address confirmation and we publish final PDF invoices.
- Mar 15: Accounting cut-off — payment due per your normal terms.

We will issue:
- Invoice 1 (Solacity Labs GmbH): credit line for 18 seats for remainder of month = EUR 25,419.35 credit note; net amount due after credit will be shown on the invoice PDF.
- Invoice 2 (Solacity EU Ops B.V.): charge line for 18 seats for remainder of month + 2TB storage prorated (EUR numbers to be shown on final).

I've attached the DocuSign envelope we will send for the subsidiary billing address declaration (docusign_splitchange_signed.pdf) — please sign when you see it.

Marissa
Head of Accounting Programs | Redwood Inference

---

On Thu, 11 Mar 2027 at 15:48:00 +0100, Marco Diaz <m.diaz@solacity.com> wrote:
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Elena Kirov <e.kirov@solacity.com>, Solacity Finance <billing@solacity.com>
Subject: Re: mid-period billing question — entity split and storage change

All good — we reviewed the provisional worksheet and confirm:
- Transfer effective 2027-03-10 00:00 UTC;
- HQ (Solacity Labs GmbH) keeps 22 seats; VAT DE123456789 applies;
- Subsidiary (Solacity EU Ops B.V.) receives 18 seats + 2TB storage; VAT NL987654321 applies;
- We prefer Option A (two invoices).

Signed the DocuSign this morning (you should see the envelope signed). Please send final invoices and the credit note for our records. One last ask: can you include the line-level proration math in the invoice PDF or an accompanying CSV? Our auditors like per-day math for internal reconciliation.

Thanks for the speedy turn.
Marco

[Attachments referenced: proration_calculation.csv (line math), solacity_entity_statement.pdf, docusign_splitchange_signed.pdf]
